meta.title: 2万人看过的摆姿逻辑…看完不用记动作了
meta.title_en: The Pose Logic 20k People Loved — No Need to Memorize Poses

scenes.title_cn: 开场：摄影师怎么记住这么多摆姿和动作…
scenes.title_en: Opening: how do photographers remember so …
scenes.context: 摆姿靠逻辑而非死记硬背。
sentences: 只要你清楚了摆姿背后的逻辑，你会发现原来不是你记不住动作。
Once you grasp the logic behind posing, you'll find it's not that you can't remember.
the logic（逻辑）
你被过去的记法困住了。
You're trapped by how you used to memorize.
trapped by old memory（被旧记法困住）
scenes.speak: Once you grasp the logic behind posing, you'll find it's not that you can't remember. You're trapped by how you used to memorize.

scenes.title_cn: 坐姿三场景：坐姿主要有这三个场景——…
scenes.title_en: Sitting in three settings: chairs, steps, …
sentences: 坐姿主要有这三个场景：椅子、台阶、地面，遵从从高到低的原则。
Sitting has three settings—chair, steps, ground—following high to low.
high to low（从高到低）
坐在椅子上，腿可以两腿张开、并拢，或者是翘二郎腿。
On a chair, legs can spread, together, or crossed.
leg options（腿的姿势）
scenes.speak: Sitting has three settings—chair, steps, ground—following high to low. On a chair, legs can spread, together, or crossed.

scenes.title_cn: 台阶与地面坐姿：台阶比较常见的就是一…
scenes.title_en: Steps and ground: on steps, the common mov…
scenes.context: 一前一后显腿长+坐姿互通。
sentences: 台阶上腿一前一后，会显得腿比较长。
On steps, one leg forward and one back lengthens the legs.
one forward one back（一前一后）
双腿交叉身体侧坐，这样比较浪漫一些。
Crossed legs with a sideways body feels more romantic.
romantic feel（浪漫）
很多用在台阶上的姿势都可以用在坐在地上。
Many step poses transfer to the ground.
poses transfer（姿势互通）
scenes.speak: On steps, one leg forward and one back lengthens the legs. Crossed legs with a sideways body feels more romantic. Many step poses transfer to the ground.

scenes.title_cn: 蹲姿与跪姿：蹲姿一般都是侧身蹲，主要…
scenes.title_en: Squats and kneeling: squats are always sid…
scenes.context: 蹲姿看膝高、跪躺趴分场景。
sentences: 蹲姿一般都是侧身蹲，主要看膝盖的高度变化。
Squats are always side-facing, keyed on knee height changes.
knee height change（膝盖高度变化）
跪姿比较有视觉冲击力，适合辣妹风格。
Kneeling has visual impact, suited to edgy styles.
visual impact（视觉冲击力）
躺姿和趴姿比较适合居家和草坪这两个场景。
Lying and prone fit home and lawn settings.
home and lawn（居家草坪）
scenes.speak: Squats are always side-facing, keyed on knee height changes. Kneeling has visual impact, suited to edgy styles. Lying and prone fit home and lawn settings.

scenes.title_cn: 手部摆放：接下来重点讲手该怎么放。有…
scenes.title_en: Hand placement: the big lesson—if there's …
scenes.context: 有道具拿道具，无道具摸到脚。
sentences: 有道具就拿道具，没道具我们就从头摸到脚。
If there's a prop, hold it; if not, work from head to toe.
head to toe（从头摸到脚）
先从头开始，摸额头挡太阳，或者去抓头发。
Start at the head—touch the forehead to shade the sun, or grab your hair.
start at the head（从头开始）
上半身歪头打招呼、插腰，下半身插兜或者提裙子。
Upper body greets, hips; lower body pockets or skirt.
upper and lower body（上下半身）
paraphrase: start at the head（从头开始
start at the head（从头开始
scenes.speak: If there's a prop, hold it; if not, work from head to toe. Start at the head—touch the forehead to shade the sun, or grab your hair. Upper body greets, hips; lower body pockets or skirt.

scenes.title_cn: 策划技巧：到这里公司已经掌握了不下3…
scenes.title_en: The planning trick: by now you've mastered…
scenes.context: 拍摄前策划姿势参考方案。
sentences: 每次拍摄前我都会去做一个策划，告诉客户具体的姿势参考方案。
Before every shoot I plan and give the client a pose reference set.
shoot plan（拍摄策划）
即使它不会摆动作，你看完图以后再去纠正，效率会更高。
Even if they can't pose, you reference and correct—more efficient.
reference and correct（看图纠正）
scenes.speak: Before every shoot I plan and give the client a pose reference set. Even if they can't pose, you reference and correct—more efficient.

practice: Chair, steps, ground—follow high to low.
One leg forward, one back lengthens the legs.
Side squat, keyed on knee height changes.
Props to hold, or work from head to toe.
Plan pose references before every shoot.
pitfalls: Hold a prop or work head to toe.
手有道具拿道具，无道具摸到脚。
Give clients a pose reference set.
Force agile moves on the ground.
Most step poses transfer to the ground.
台阶姿势可通用到地面。
shifts: 用 high to low（从高到低）、side squat（侧身蹲）、knee height change（膝盖高度变化）
用 head to toe（从头摸到脚）、prop（道具）、gestures（手势）
用 pose reference（姿势参考）、shoot plan（拍摄策划）、mind map（思维导图）
